result.summary: Found 3 visible issues: a search placeholder typo and two carousel clipping problems that make content look unfinished.

issues.description: The category carousel ends with a partially visible blank pill on the right edge, with no readable label. It looks like a broken or empty category.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel spacing or initial scroll position so the next chip shows enough of its label, or hide the partial chip until it can be meaningfully displayed.

issues.description: The search placeholder says “Restarants, dishes, groceries”; “Restaurants” is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Change the placeholder to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries”.

issues.description: The third card in “Fastest near you” is cut off at the right edge, including its restaurant name and delivery text, with no ellipsis or clean clipping treatment.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel card widths and viewport padding, and apply an intentional fade, mask, or text ellipsis to partially visible cards.
